## Method and limitations

- The JSON document retains the complete Morpho GraphQL position inventory returned for this chain.
- Market ids are checked against keccak256(abi.encode(MarketParams)); immutable market parameters are verified against Morpho idToMarketParams.
- Candidate positions are read from the Morpho singleton at the recorded block. Eligibility uses Morpho's rounding rules: borrow assets round up; collateral value and LLTV capacity round down.
- Accrued interest uses Morpho's wTaylorCompounded formula and the IRM borrowRateView.
- The forward scenario assumes constant current borrow rate and constant current oracle price. Future rate changes, market activity, and oracle movements can change outcomes.
- Every position returned by the Morpho GraphQL inventory is individually read from the Morpho singleton, using Multicall3 batches of 250 where available and bounded direct-call fallback otherwise. The source does not expose indexer lag; completeness is therefore bounded by the indexer inventory and freshness.
- Read-only only; no transactions or contract deployments.


## Sources

- Morpho REST market catalogue: https://api.morpho.org/v1/blue/markets (chain-scoped, cursor-paginated).
- Morpho GraphQL position inventory: https://api.morpho.org/graphql (chain-scoped, offset-paginated).
- Morpho Blue singleton: 0xBBBBBbbBBb9cC5e90e3b3Af64bdAF62C37EEFFCb; market parameters, market state, and borrower positions read at block 26325649.
- Market oracle price() and configured IRM borrowRateView() read at the same block.
- Token metadata: Morpho REST /v0/tokens/{chainId}:{tokenAddress}.
- RPC secret is selected by chain ID: RPC_KATANA for Katana (747474) or RPC_ETHEREUM for Ethereum (1).
